content:
New AI Models

This week, new foundational models focused on various use cases were introduced. Developments in on-device inference and the healthcare sector are particularly noteworthy:

  • Falcon H1R 7B: Developed by TII, this compact hybrid inference engine delivers higher performance than its peers in its size class on math and coding tasks and doubles inference speed.
  • LFM 2.5: Liquid AI’s family of open-weight models, designed for on-device use, features text, image, and audio processing capabilities.
  • LTX-2: Lightricks has released its AI video model—capable of generating natural 4K video and synchronized audio—as open source.
  • SleepFM: Stanford researchers have announced a foundational model capable of predicting over 130 health conditions from sleep recordings.

CES 2026 and Hardware Developments

The CES 2026 trade show served as the main platform for showcasing AI-focused hardware and integrations:

  • Nvidia Rubin Platform: A new AI supercomputer architecture offering five times more training compute power than the Blackwell series was introduced.
  • Lenovo Qira: A system-level AI assistant that enables contextual tracking between PCs and Motorola phones was announced.
  • Razer Project AVA: A concept for a holographic AI assistant based on Grok and operating inside a physical cylinder was showcased.
  • Automotive Integrations: Ford plans to add AI assistants to its vehicles starting in 2027, while Boston Dynamics announced it will use Google DeepMind infrastructure in its next-generation Atlas robot.

Platforms and Application Updates

On the software front, product-focused expansions continue at OpenAI and Google:

  • ChatGPT Health: OpenAI announced a new module that offers personalized responses to health-related questions, featuring a separate memory and chat history.
  • Google Gemini Integrations: Gemini features have been more deeply integrated into Google TV, Classroom, and Gmail services.
  • Traffic Data: Following the launch of Gemini 3, a decline in ChatGPT web traffic was observed, while an increase in Gemini traffic was reported.
  • Amazon Alexa: The Alexa+ experience has been extended to web browsers, introducing content creation and smart home management features.

Investment and Acquisition Updates

Capital flows in the AI ecosystem continue with large-scale funding rounds and strategic acquisitions:

  • xAI: Elon Musk’s company raised $20 billion in a Series E funding round.
  • Anthropic: It was reported that the company is preparing for a new $10 billion funding round at a $350 billion valuation.
  • Acquisitions: Snowflake acquired the observability platform Observe; Mobileye acquired the humanoid robotics startup Mentee Robotics (for $900 million). OpenAI, meanwhile, brought the Convogo team on board.
  • Other Investments: LMArena ($150 million), Articul8 ($35 million), and Protege ($30 million) completed their funding rounds.
